summary: UiLayout - one BFLYT layout instance of the UI layer: it owns the root pane, the pane-name (group) registry, the animation/slot tables and a 239-entry table of resolved named layout parts (resource pointer + pack handle) that each UI screen binds when it loads.
evidence: Ui_Layout_AllocSlotNode 0x0017ACC0 stores vtable 0x007585CC; Ui_Layout_LoadBflyt 0x0053D77C parses the 'FLYT'/'grp1' sections and fills rootPane +0x10, pane registry +0x14 and layoutId +0x24; maybe_Ui_Layout_LoadAndBind_Type1 0x006D9DC4 resolves ~100 named parts into the 8-byte slot table at +0x2B4..+0xA24. Caveat: the M1 'Ui_Layout_' prefix also absorbed function groups that actually operate on sibling objects (UiLayoutPlayer vtable 0x0078144C seen by ReleaseChildren/ResetChildren, the Sound_3D helpers at 0x00542xxx, field/NPC node slots in the shared vtable 0x007585CC, and the embedded slot/style/text objects), so header offsets that are aliases of those helper objects are marked unknown_* rather than given a false layout meaning.
